🗡️ RPG Skill Icon Pack
========================

This pack includes 187 skill icons crafted in a clean 16×16 resolution, perfect for RPGs, adventure games, fantasy projects, and more.  
These icons can be used for skills, buffs, status effects, weapons, abilities, and UI elements.

Contents (Ver 1.7)
--------
• 165 unique skill icons (16×16 pixels)  
• Available in 6 color variants: Red, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple, and Black  
• Includes upscaled 32×32 versions for flexible use  
• 7(+12 color variants) skill borders to classify icon rarities (Wood, Silver, Obsidian,Color Variants etc.)  

Ideal for:
- HUDs  
- Inventories  
- Skill trees  
- Ability menus  
- Item systems
